mike-knoop.bio: Mike Knoop is a co-founder of Zapier and of the ARC Prize, which he launched in 2024 to speed progress toward artificial general intelligence. The ARC Prize site lists him as Co-founder and Board Member.

facts.text: Zapier co-founder who launched the ARC Prize in 2024.
Listed as Co-founder and Board Member on the ARC Prize team page.

francois-chollet.bio: François Chollet is the creator of Keras and defined the ARC-AGI benchmark in 2019 to measure general intelligence. The ARC Prize's official profile names him as a co-founder.

facts.text: Defined the ARC-AGI benchmark in 2019 to measure general intelligence.
The ARC-AGI repository is hosted under his own fchollet GitHub account.
